The 0.5.x names, kept as aliases

Source: R/compat_names.R, R/compat_s3.R
rmbl-aliases.Rd

Every function rmoriebricklayer 0.5.13 exported that 1.0.0 renamed is still callable by its old name, with its old argument names and its old defaults: each alias forwards to the new function. Allowed values that were renamed ("mean_bootstrap" is now "meanboot") are translated on the way, as are old argument names passed through .... rate(), rate_change(), share() and yoy_summary() stay S3 generics, so methods written for them still dispatch. An option set under its 0.5.x name (rmoriebricklayer.xmss_index_file, rmoriebricklayer.data_cache ...) is read when the new name is not set. The reference documentation lives on the new name; this page only lists the aliases.

Details

Results are not translated: their columns and fields carry the new names. The last table lists every renamed one, so old code that reads a result can be updated.
